task: Identify the hardware requirements for using the latest version of Adobe Photoshop on a Mac.
answer: Hardware requirements for the latest Adobe Photoshop on Mac (Technical requirements for version 27.x and later, per helpx.adobe.com): Processor: Multicore Intel or Apple Silicon processor (ARM-based Apple Silicon recommended); Operating system: macOS v26, v15.x, v14.x (cannot be installed on macOS 12.x.x Monterey or earlier); RAM: 8 GB minimum, 16 GB or more recommended; AVX2 and SSE 4.2 support required; Graphics card: Metal support required; Monitor: 1280 x 800 or higher (1920 x 1080 recommended); Video RAM: 1.5 GB (2 GB recommended); Hard disk: 10 GB available space for installation (100 GB recommended, fast internal SSD), cannot install on case-sensitive file systems; Internet connection and registration required for activation.
